deviceId="%ID设备" timestamp="%time" requestId="%ucid"
body="{}"
# 前缀（key 前 32 字节异或结果，固定值） inner_prefix="636075446746055152425b025c66575062430464014c55616663535846575474" outer_prefix="090a1f2e0d2c6f3b38283168360c3d3a08296e0e6b263f0b0c0939322c3d3e1e"
inner_key_hex="${inner_prefix}3636363636363636363636363636363636363636363636363636363636363636" outer_key_hex="${outer_prefix}5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c5c"
# 1. MD5 md5=$(printf '%s' "$body" | md5sum | awk '{print $1}')
# 2. 签名原文 sign_str="POST;/api/v1/token/device;${md5};${timestamp};xiaoyi;${deviceId};${requestId}"
# 3. 消息十六进制 msg_hex=$(printf '%s' "$sign_str" | xxd -p | tr -d '\n')
# 4. inner hash inner_hash=$(printf '%s%s' "$inner_key_hex" "$msg_hex" | xxd -r -p | sha256sum -b)
# 5. HMAC hmac_hex=$(printf '%s%s' "$outer_key_hex" "$inner_hash" | xxd -r -p | sha256sum -b)
# 6. Base64 URL-safe sign_base64=$(printf '%s' "$hmac_hex" | xxd -r -p | base64 | tr -d '\n' | tr '+/' '-_' | sed 's/=*$//')
echo "sign=${sign_base64};time=${timestamp}"
